hostHint: The adapter finds the host by itself as long as it sits in the same network segment as the speakers. SSDP is not forwarded between segments - in that case enter the addresses here.
hostAddressHelp: Leave empty for automatic discovery. The host is the device offering the ConfigDevice, recognisable by the open port 47365.
bindAddressHelp: Only needed when the machine has several network cards. Enter the address of the card that sits in the speakers' segment.
